banner:
Explore Grafana Play through Interactive Learning

Choose a hands-on guide below to explore live dashboards and features on play.grafana.org at your own pace. Each guide opens in a new tab with step-by-step interactive instructions.

rules.title: Welcome to Grafana Play
rules.description: Tour the Grafana Play homepage and discover available demo dashboards.

rules.title: Visualization Examples
rules.description: Explore visualization types and panel options in Grafana Play.

rules.title: Data Source Examples
rules.description: Browse data source examples available in Grafana Play.

rules.title: Tour of Grafana 13 Features
rules.description: Hands-on tour of Grafana 13 features running on Play, including SQL expressions, Graphviz panel visualization, and the new visualization suggestions.

rules.title: Tour of Grafana Visualizations
rules.description: A quick tour of Grafana's visualization types—when to use each one, with live examples.

rules.title: BI in Grafana: Semantic Layer
rules.description: Interactive demo: Explore how a Semantic Layer enhances BI dashboards in Grafana with cross-filtering, generated SQL, and dynamic JOINs.

rules.title: CPU Usage in Namespaces
rules.description: Hands-on guide: Explore CPU usage in Kubernetes Monitoring, from namespaces to containers.

rules.title: Memory Usage in Kubernetes Namespaces
rules.description: Hands-on guide: Explore memory usage in Kubernetes Monitoring, from namespaces to containers.

rules.title: Read a Trace on the Public Demo
rules.description: Open a real trace with live demo data and learn to read its span waterfall—nesting, durations, service and operation names, and attributes—with no account or setup.

rules.title: Analyzing 5K Run Results with Grafana Transformations
rules.description: See how Grafana transformations turn raw finish timestamps into a full race analysis. No data changes required—everything is derived inside Grafana.

rules.title: Tour the UK Carbon Intensity Dashboard
rules.description: Explore live UK carbon intensity data with the Infinity data source and JQ expressions. Learn how this dashboard visualizes the electricity generation mix and carbon intensity across regions.

rules.title: Tour the CheerLights Dashboard
rules.description: A guided tour of the CheerLights dashboard, exploring how a single Infinity query loads IoT color-change events from the ThingSpeak API into a table panel that powers the rest of the dashboard.

rules.title: Explore an Authenticated API with the Chicago L Trains Dashboard
rules.description: A guided tour of the Chicago L Trains dashboard, showing how the Infinity data source authenticates against the CTA Train Tracker API with a stored key, how JQ reshapes the response, and how every stat panel reuses that one query.

rules.title: Take a Tour of the Eurovision 2026 Dashboard
rules.description: A guided tour of the Eurovision 2026 dashboard on Grafana Play, exploring how the data is transformed and visualized.

rules.title: Tour the Great Britain Railway Station Usage Dashboard
rules.description: A guided tour of the GB railway station usage dashboard, exploring how an inline CSV powers a ranked station leaderboard and derived percentage statistics using Grafana transformations.

rules.title: Explore New Zealand Seismic Data with Infinity and JQ
rules.description: A guided tour of the New Zealand GeoNet dashboard, showing how the Infinity data source and JQ parser fetch live earthquake and volcanic activity data from a public API.

rules.title: Explore SQL Expressions with The Traitors UK Dashboard
rules.description: A guided tour of the Traitors UK Series 4 dashboard, exploring how SQL expressions are used to transform raw Google Sheets data into rich visualizations.
